environment: Halo 3 SDK tag test on Onyx-Linux using an isolated extracted editing kit; not retail MCC
scope: Nine compact live pages for all 50 skills, rank/state markers, selected-skill detail, separate wallet and next price, and bounded menu/recovery checks. This is a development candidate, not a promoted release.

markers.o: Purchased with more ranks remaining; does not promise affordability

model.refresh: At most once per 30 simulation ticks while the Armory is open; purchase/input processing precedes refresh.

compile.basis: Native operator reports successful compilation and save; parsed saved-scenario readback contains 495 scripts, 180 globals, 51,074 syntax datums and 127 titles. The final candidate also executed the seven fresh assertions in the final phase.
compile.log_limit: The retained compile log is cumulative. Its hash does not establish a warning-free build, and no compiler process exit code is claimed.

readback_transfer.limit: The public transfer helper only verifies copied bytes and an idle process snapshot; compilation is supported separately by the native operator, parsed saved tag and subsequent SDK execution.

compiler_budget.initial_failure: The larger live graph candidate crashed during native script compilation with an overrun of the 245,760-byte allocation at hs_compile.cpp:473. Script/global definition counts alone did not prevent this failure.
compiler_budget.inspected_binary_finding: Static inspection of the owned January 3, 2024 x64 Sapien binary identified a script/global-reference bookkeeping table with 24-byte records and capacity 10,240. Its append routine lacks a pre-append capacity check. This is specific to that binary, not a universal engine limit.
compiler_budget.reduction: A shared bounded target-consideration helper removes repeated combat predicates, and inline graph digits remove redundant global writes. The nine-page graph retains all 50 nodes.
compiler_budget.limit: The authored estimate excludes engine-injected material and is not an exact native allocation count. Native compilation remains required.

evidence_method.reverification: Each private archived log was independently read. Its entire SHA256, pre-dispatch prefix SHA256, end offset and receipt command were checked. Exactly one complete SDK warning-envelope marker for the assertion nonce was decoded within the fresh bounded window; echoed console commands were not accepted as evidence.
evidence_method.context_binding_limit: Receipt candidate/profile labels are supplied by the native operator. Hash/marker verification does not independently establish process identity or loaded-candidate provenance; the operator associates each phase with its build and isolated QA session.
evidence_method.publication: Only sanitized summaries, commands, outcomes and hashes are published. Private absolute paths, raw logs, owned tags, saves and captured game images are excluded.

setup_and_observations: The native operator inspected all nine pages using real category navigation. This was the earlier presentation; it does not prove every final-style page or all 601 snapshots.
Real purchase input reached Needler Power rank two with one point remaining. The 1.5-second held click did not buy an additional rank.
Short ordinary stage-one combat advanced time and shots, earned a level, and returned to the Armory with rank two and two points.

After process restart through Continue, bounded assertions observed the same rank/tokens, positive progress and live actors at or below the cap. These checks did not compare every timer, actor identity or cooldown exactly.
Branch tests explicitly seeded stage 3, 50 points and Needler Rate rank two. Subsequent stage-four testing explicitly changed the stage; these are not ordinary progression or balance evidence.

incorrect_expectations.explanation: The test expected a stage-four capstone purchase and its wallet deduction while the game was still seeded at stage three. Both FAIL observations are retained. The corrected stage-three gate, exclusive-branch rejection, then stage-four purchase and 43-point wallet assertions passed; they do not rewrite the original failures.

observations.summary: A complete Needler graph visibly shows Power1o on the opaque black panel, with white wallet text showing 2 points and next-rank price 1. The selected objective supplies skill effects and prerequisites.
The capture approximately two seconds after Resume shows outdoor overhead combat with the black panel, graph, wallet and price absent. It does not establish exact sub-second disappearance timing.
The actual Space+Q reopen capture shows the complete AR page, wallet 3 and next price 2 on the black panel. The menu-open assertion separately passed.

After process restart and Continue, fresh assertions observed an open Armory, Needler Power rank one, 3 points, positive time/shots, level above one, and live actors at or below 36. This is bounded state retention, not exact equality of every field.

Some captures fall during a refresh gap and show an incomplete or absent graph, wallet or next-price text. Readable complete frames exist, but zero flicker and continuous visibility have not been established.
